metadata.method: Layered A* through all supplied waypoint stationareas; strict known gauge; all connections from real rail or crossover OSM geometry. No virtual gap connections. Lines simplified18 m for rendering. lengthKm is approximate geodesic track distance; commuter lengths use unsimplified vertices, strategic lengths use simplified18 m traces.
metadata.limitations: Paths are computed cartography, not Renfe-verified timetables or operating paths. OSM snapshot is not a certified2022/future network. Station sources and legacy catalogue status per snap. Missing paths remain unavailable without fictitious segments. Infrastructure-only lines in2026 may not reflect disruptions or temporary replacement buses.
